title: Exodus Bible Quiz - Chapter 26
description: Ten questions on Exodus 26: the curtains, coverings, boards, veil and screen of the tabernacle.

questions.text: What figures were worked into the ten curtains of fine twined linen?
questions.explanation: The ten curtains of fine twined linen, blue, purple and scarlet were to be made with cherubim, the work of a skillful workman.

questions.text: What were the fifty clasps that joined the linen curtains made of?
questions.explanation: Fifty clasps of gold were to couple the curtains to one another, so the tabernacle would be a unit.

questions.text: What were the eleven curtains for the covering over the tabernacle made of?
questions.explanation: Curtains of goats' hair were to be made for a covering over the tabernacle, eleven curtains in all.

questions.text: What was the top covering, above the covering of rams' skins dyed red?
questions.explanation: There was to be a covering of rams' skins dyed red, and a covering of sea cow hides above.

questions.text: How long was each board of the tabernacle?
questions.explanation: Ten cubits was the length of a board, and one and a half cubits its width.

questions.text: What were the sockets under the boards made of?
questions.explanation: Forty sockets of silver were to be made under the twenty boards, two under each board.

questions.text: What was special about the middle bar?
questions.explanation: The middle bar in the middle of the boards was to pass through from end to end.

answers.text: It passed through the boards from end to end
It was used to carry the ark
It supported the roof of goats' hair

questions.explanation: The veil was to separate the holy place from the most holy place.

answers.text: The court from the rest of the camp
The altar from the bronze basin
The priests from the rest of the Levites
The holy place from the most holy place

questions.text: Where was the table to be placed?
questions.explanation: The table was to be set outside the veil, on the north side, with the lamp stand opposite it on the south side.

answers.text: On the south side, next to the lamp stand
Outside the veil, on the north side
At the gate of the court

questions.text: Whose work was the screen for the door of the Tent?
questions.explanation: The screen for the door of the Tent, of blue, purple, scarlet and fine twined linen, was to be the work of the embroiderer.
